summary: Iter 107 retest of the XSS fix in /app/backend/services/qr_share_page_service.py (_js() escapes <, >, & as \u003c/\u003e/\u0026 in JSON literals inlined into <script>). Ran the existing iter106 pytest suite (5/5 PASS incl. the previously-failing caption-with-script test) and a new iter107 xss-fix suite (3/3 PASS) that specifically asserts (a) response body must NOT contain '</script>hi' or '<script>alert' anywhere, (b) response body MUST contain the escaped '\u003cscript\u003ealert(1)\u003c/script\u003ehi' literal, (c) name='<b>x' is also escaped, (d) invalid code still 404, (e) regression normal caption with emoji + https link still 200 w/ Cache-Control:no-store, navigator.share, 'Share on WhatsApp' button label. Playwright mobile-viewport (420x800) load of the exact XSS URL from the request: no alert dialog fires, #cap innerText equals literal '<script>alert(1)</script>hi', #go button visible with text 'Share on WhatsApp', zero JS/page console errors, and no raw '<b>x' present in DOM source (though it is rendered as inert text inside the poster SVG image, which is safe). XSS fix verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: _js() correctly escapes <, >, & as \u escapes — this defeats the '</script>' script-breakout, '<!--' HTML-comment breakout, and '<script>' nested-open, all at once. Good choice over the minimal '</'→'<\\/' fix.

Poster SVG (qr_poster_service.render_poster) still receives raw name/site/trust query params and embeds them into SVG text — verified via the '<b>x' name payload rendering as inert visible text '<b>x' inside the poster PNG (not HTML). Confirms the SVG path is XML-escaped. No action needed.
Order of replace() in _js is safe: '&' → '\u0026' happens LAST so it doesn't double-escape the '&' inside earlier-produced '\u003c' sequences (those contain no '&'). Correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: XSS fix in qr_share_page_service._js() is verified. If share-page ever accepts new query params that get inlined into the <script> block, route them through _js() too. Regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_merchant_qr_share_page_iter106.py and /app/backend/tests/test_merchant_qr_share_page_iter107.py — both need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or fall back to hardcoded preview URL.
rca of the issue: Original bug: json.dumps output was inlined verbatim inside <script> — JSON does not require escaping '</' so a caption containing '</script>' terminated the outer <script> tag at the HTML-parser level. Fix: services/qr_share_page_service.py:_js() runs json.dumps then .replace('<','\u003c').replace('>','\u003e').replace('&','\u0026') on the result. Verified: (1) source body contains '\u003cscript\u003ealert(1)\u003c/script\u003ehi' and does NOT contain '</script>hi' or '<script>alert'; (2) at runtime JS sees the correct string 'AC<script>alert(1)</script>hi' and injects it into #cap via HTML-escaping innerHTML so no alert fires and no rogue DOM is created.
